title: CTV Is the Key to Rapid Growth for Small Businesses

facts.fact: In a vendor-sponsored case study, MNTN reports that a CTV campaign for Houston Hyundai Auto Group delivered an 81% month-over-month improvement in cost per acquisition.
facts.unit: % month-over-month improvement in cost per acquisition
facts.quote: The CTV campaign delivered an 81% month-over-month improvement for cost per acquisition.

facts.fact: In the same vendor-sponsored case study, MNTN reports that site visits went up by 11% after the Houston Hyundai Auto Group CTV campaign.
facts.quote: Additionally, site visits went up by 11% and average raw conversions increased by 24%.

facts.fact: In the same vendor-sponsored case study, MNTN reports that average raw conversions increased by 24% after the Houston Hyundai Auto Group CTV campaign.
facts.quote: Additionally, site visits went up by 11% and average raw conversions increased by 24%.

facts.fact: The sponsored article states that traditional TV advertising was reserved for roughly a few thousand advertisers among millions of advertisers in the ad world.
facts.quote: That meant they were traditionally reserved only for a certain section of the ad world—a few thousand advertisers among millions.
